integrity: Complete internal proof and independent definition-based small-graph computation; external validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact domain r>=1,s>=2 only; other split graphs are not treated.
The scalar geodesic-transversal number is covered by a prior general join theorem and is not independently new.
Equivalent work in unindexed literature is a possible priority risk.
Finite checks support but cannot replace the parameter-uniform proof.
title: Geodesic packing and transversal censuses of complete split graphs
